content.title: Big Banks poised to end year at record highs, wider goals for 2026
content.description:
Big Bank stocks are set to close out 2025 at record-highs while projecting even broader growth goals for 2026. Yahoo Finance senior banking reporter David Hollerith sits down with Josh Lipton to talk about the banking sector's guidance and capital forecasts for the coming year.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
